reviewScope: Internal functional and numerical-model review, not independent expert, official board, physical-all-device/touch/FPS or printer certification. Selected sodium oleate and neutral octyl glucoside do not represent all formulations. Soap precipitation is ideal with proportional Ca/Mg allocation; no Ksp, pH, kinetic or empirical washing model. The neutral reference has no divalent carboxylate channel; other associations and clouding omitted. Unprecipitated inventory is not necessarily free monomer and predicts neither foam nor cleansing efficiency. The published 20–25 mmol/L CMC band at 20–25 °C is only a reference, not this mixture CMC. Selected 1 g/mL prepared density and additive nominal volumes; carrier excludes solutes. No solid-volume, atom-position, bond-geometry or actuator-force model. Artificial tracer colours, flow glyphs and product marks are qualitative.
